title: Residue detection of pulled-back single cohomology
statement: Let $Y,Y\prime$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $g:Y\prime\to Y$ a morphism, $d,i,r\in\mathbb N$, and $P$ a cochain complex of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-pc-derived-category] with zero terms below $0$ and above $d$ and terms isomorphic to finite free modules [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let $g^*P$ and $P_y$ be termwise pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback], the latter along $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(y)\to Y$. Then $H^q(g^*P)=0$ for every $q\in\mathbb N\setminus\{i\}$ and $H^i(g^*P)$ is finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] if and only if, for every $y$ in the image of $g$, $H^q(P_y)=0$ for every $q\in\mathbb N\setminus\{i\}$ and $H^i(P_y)$ is finite locally free of rank $r$.

proof.text: For each source point z, apply lem-pc-finite-free-residue-local-homotopy to the residue hypothesis at g(z). Choose its open U_z and homotopy equivalence. The U_z cover the source because z belongs to U_z. Exact open restriction commutes with cohomology, and homotopy equivalences induce homology isomorphisms. The homology of a single free complex is zero off i and free of rank r at i. Vanishing glues by isZero_of_iSup_eq_top; the explicit restricted free isomorphisms glue finite local freeness by isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_restrict_iso_free. The empty source is included by the empty point-indexed cover.

For the converse, let z map to y and let Q=g^*P. Pullback preserves the strict support bounds and termwise finite freeness. Apply lem-pc-finite-free-single-field-fibre to Q along Spec κ(z)→Y\prime. Its homotopy equivalence computes the required single cohomology of this fibre. The ordinary pullback composition isomorphism pullbackComp, mapped to complexes and then homology, identifies it with the fibre of P along Spec κ(z)→Y.

Compare this field-valued point with Spec κ(y)→Y. For a matrix of global functions, le_rank_map_appTop_iff characterizes every lower bound on its rank by a nonvanishing minor at the image point. Since the two points have the same image, the ranks are equal. Apply this to the incoming and outgoing differentials in each degree. The proved source-library formula finrank_homology_pullback_add_rank_add_rank then makes the two cohomology dimensions equal, by cancellation in the natural numbers. The source-library finite_moduleSpecΓFunctor_obj_homology_pullback gives finite-dimensionality. On the spectrum of a field, zero cohomology is equivalent to dimension zero, and finite local freeness of rank r is equivalent to dimension r. Transport the computed vanishing and dimension r across the dimension equality. Every image point has a source preimage by definition of Set.range. The three private helpers of the module carry the matrix-rank comparison, dimension comparison and single homology computation explicitly in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteFree_pullback_single_iff_residue
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (hge : P.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hle : P.IsStrictlyLE d)
    (hfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (i r : ℕ) {Y' : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y' ⟶ Y) :
    ((∀ q : ℕ, q ≠ i → IsZero
        ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P).homology q)) ∧
      ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
        P).homology i).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r) ↔
      ∀ y ∈ Set.range g.base, ((∀ q : ℕ, q ≠ i → IsZero
          ((((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecResidueField y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
            P).homology q)) ∧
        ((((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecResidueField y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
          P).homology i).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r)
